standard-dialogue.player: Hello. What do you do here?

standard-dialogue.npc: My name is Gnosi. I am here to assist the Varrock Museum in their research.

standard-dialogue.player: I didn't know the Varrock Museum was familiar with this continent. What research are you conducting?

standard-dialogue.npc: We're studying the history of the region, origins of the lizardmen and how it all connects to Xeric.
We've wanted to study this place for a while, but haven't been able to explore due to lizardmen blocking the way.
But now that the Shayzien Army have cleared the path and discovered the Chambers of Xeric in the process, there is much to explore!

steps.npc: Xeric was an incredibly powerful dark mage. He ruled Great Kourend for ten decades.
If you'd like to find out more you should visit the Historical Archive at the Grand Library.

options.text: What are the Chambers of Xeric?

steps.player: What are the Chambers of Xeric?

steps.npc: At the summit of this mountain we've found an ancient temple and a vast network of caves that we believe were formed by Xeric and his followers.
The discovery of the Chambers tells us Xeric invested significant time and resources here, yet it was never documented.
While much of Kourend's history under Xeric remains unknown, it is very surprising to discover such a huge area that was previously undiscovered to us.
Of course, though be careful. The dangers of the Chambers of Xeric are as yet unknown. You should take a strong group of companions with you.

options.text: What do you think Xeric used this area for?

steps.player: What do you think Xeric used this area for?

steps.npc: When he ruled Kourend, we know Xeric performed experiments on the living, using power drawn from the Dark Altar. After he was overthrown, he would have needed a new source of power.

steps.text: If the player has not completed Tale of the Righteous:

steps.npc: We believe he came here to seek it. Xeric would also have required a source of many creatures for these experiments, and the Chambers certainly contain many of those!
He must have also had some form of teleportation in order to reach the temple unnoticed.
With time and careful study we will uncover these secrets and be able to answer these questions.

steps.text: If the player has completed Tale of the Righteous:

steps.npc: We believe this altar is that source. It seems to act as an amplifier for the Dark Altar.
As for what he used the Chambers for, that we still don't know. There's a lot of creatures in the Chambers. Maybe he used them in his experiments.

after-completion-of-tale-of-the-righteou.npc: The discovery of this cave could change everything. We might finally be able to discover the link between the lizardmen, the Chambers of Xeric and Xeric himself.
